brief: 6 security tools every startup should run before their first enterprise deal.

slots.desc1: Automate SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA compliance in weeks.
slots.desc2: Find and fix vulnerabilities in code, containers, and dependencies.
slots.desc3: Secure team access with Zero Trust WAF and identity protection.
slots.desc4: Scan secrets, dependencies, and code leaks across every repo.
slots.desc5: Share credentials and secrets without spreadsheets or Slack DMs.

slots.toolTagline: The fastest way to get audit-ready and close enterprise deals.
slots.bigStatement: Vanta automates 80% of your security compliance workload so you can ship SOC 2 in weeks, not quarters.
slots.use1Body: Pull screenshots and logs from AWS, GitHub, and Google continuously.
slots.use2Body: Use pre-built security policies mapped to SOC 2 controls.
slots.use3Body: Monitor third-party risk and vendor security reviews centrally.

slots.toolTagline: Developer-first security that scans code, dependencies, and containers.
slots.bigStatement: Snyk finds vulnerabilities in your open-source dependencies before attackers do, keeping your CI/CD pipeline clean.
slots.use1Body: Detect critical CVEs in npm, Python, and Go packages automatically.
slots.use2Body: Scan Docker images for misconfigurations and OS vulnerabilities.
slots.use3Body: Catch Terraform and CloudFormation misconfigs before deployment.

slots.toolTagline: Zero Trust networking and application firewall for modern teams.
slots.bigStatement: Cloudflare replaces your VPN with a Zero Trust gateway and blocks DDoS attacks before they touch your origin.
slots.use1Body: Enforce identity-aware access to SaaS apps and internal tools.
slots.use2Body: Absorb and distribute malicious traffic across 300+ cities.
slots.use3Body: Block SQL injection and XSS with managed rule sets.

slots.toolTagline: Advanced security scanning baked into every pull request.
slots.bigStatement: GitHub Advanced Security flags secrets and dependency risks in real time, turning every repo into a hardened asset.
slots.use1Body: Detect API keys and tokens pushed to repos instantly.
slots.use2Body: Auto-open PRs to patch vulnerable dependencies before merge.
slots.use3Body: Run semantic code analysis to catch XSS and injection flaws.

slots.toolTagline: The enterprise password and secrets manager built for fast teams.
slots.bigStatement: 1Password eliminates shared spreadsheets and gives every developer vault-level access with full audit logs.
slots.use1Body: Store credentials, env files, and API keys in team vaults.
slots.use2Body: Generate and inject SSH keys into terminals without exposure.
slots.use3Body: Track who accessed what and export event logs easily.

slots.toolTagline: Lightweight endpoint detection and response for lean startups.
slots.bigStatement: CrowdStrike stops breaches on laptops and servers with AI-driven threat detection and instant remediation.
slots.use1Body: Monitor endpoints for malware and fileless attacks around the clock.
slots.use2Body: Leverage built-in IOAs to identify adversary behavior automatically.
slots.use3Body: Enforce USB and peripheral policies to prevent data exfiltration.

slots.body: Enterprise buyers demand proof. Run these six tools to close revenue faster and sleep soundly.
